title: Fix leaking ArraySearchPhaseResults during node shutdown

timeline.message:
Fix leaking ArraySearchPhaseResults during node shutdown

We should not quietly ignore exceptions during node shutdown. Lets do
what we do on the transport side and just execute on the current thread
if forking during shutdown is not possible anymore.

Closes #104361
Closes #103108
Closes #104081
timeline.author: Armin Braun

timeline.body:
We should not quietly ignore exceptions during node shutdown. Lets do what we do on the transport side and just execute on the current thread if forking during shutdown is not possible anymore.

Closes #104361
Closes #103108
Closes #104081
FTR I don't like that we do this in the transport layer, I'd rather we drained all the pending work properly before shutting down the threadpool. But I can see that this is much harder.

timeline.author: Armin Braun

timeline.body:
> I'd rather we drained all the pending work properly before shutting down the threadpool

++ I tried looking into that but it's quite a lot of work with how things work today unfortunately. I actually did a bit of that when fixing this kind of thing for recoveries during shutdown but I can't see a clean generic way of draining tasks (I could see how we would implement one though).
